title: Rate Relief Where the Owner's Service Account Stands Clear
content:
# Rate Relief Where the Owner's Service Account Stands Clear

An owner of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects who also holds one of the company's Demand Service Rate Programs and owes nothing on it is charged a smaller part of the monthly late fee rate.

## Rule

Where the owner carries an active Demand Service Rate Program that stands clear of any unpaid balance, and the amount the fee is taken on is no more than a tenth of the contract value, that is no more than 10 per cent of it, the fee is charged at half the rate the project's class charges for each month, that is at 50 per cent of that rate.

Where the owner carries an active Demand Service Rate Program that stands clear of any unpaid balance, and the amount the fee is taken on is more than a tenth of the contract value, the fee is charged at three quarters of that rate, that is at 75 per cent of it.

Where the owner carries no active Demand Service Rate Program or that program carries an unpaid balance, the fee is charged at that rate in full, at 100 per cent of it.

## Condition table

| Demand Service Rate Program | Unpaid balance on that program | Amount the fee is taken on against a tenth of the contract value | Portion of the class's monthly rate charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | none | at or below a tenth | 50 per cent |
| active | none | above a tenth | 75 per cent |
| active | some | any | 100 per cent |
| none, or not active | any | any | 100 per cent |

The tenth is taken on the contract value and rounded to the nearest cent; an amount exactly equal to it is no more than a tenth and takes the first case.

## Worked rates (hypothetical, contract value USD 500000, class rate 1.5 per cent per month)

With an active rate program clear of arrears and USD 40000 as the amount the fee is taken on, the rate charged is 0.75 per cent for the month. With the same program and USD 90000 as that amount, it is 1.125 per cent. With no rate program, it is 1.5 per cent.
